answer: Self-assessed Harberger licensing prices every identity continuously. At minting each name declares its own value - minimum 5,000 POA - carved on a jade plaque at the registry gate, owing ten percent of that sum every epoch. The trigger is a missed payment: the plaque goes to auction, wiping the squatter's deposit. A comet of one hundred clones burns 50,000 POA per round, while a yarrow farmer declaring one honest plot pays 500 and keeps it.
